land_pattern.package: LQFP48, 7x7mm body (D1=E1=7.0mm typ, overall D=E=9.0mm typ with leads), 0.5mm pitch
land_pattern.notes: From datasheet Table 94 (LQFP48 mechanical data) and Figure 50 (LQFP48 recommended footprint): 48 perimeter gull-wing leads, lead width b=0.22mm typ (0.17-0.27mm range), recommended land pad 0.30mm x 1.20mm at 0.50mm pitch. Footprint span (pad outer edge to pad outer edge) 9.70mm x 9.70mm, inner span 7.30mm x 7.30mm between pad inner edges, 5.80mm between pad centers on opposite sides (per Figure 50 dimensions 9.70/7.30/5.80/1.20/0.30/0.50). No exposed pad on this package; pad_count=48 covers only the 48 perimeter leads.
